description: 1v1: two greedy bots, hard dropping 24 and 27 frames after each piece comes in, play in lockstep, with the test harness in the server's part: it cancels each attack against the attacker's own garbage meter and queues the rest on the opponent. 60 attacks, 10 of them cancelled, 2 only in part, and 19 and 25 garbage landings, recorded as garbageAccepted. From frame 7,200 margin time multiplies attacks: at frame 7,758 player 0 sends 6 lines (5 × 1.25, rounded down). Player 1 tops out at frame 9,389, where the replay ends.
